verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's docs say passkeys are saved in the Bitwarden vault rather than a platform keychain, and can be autofilled through the browser extension and mobile apps across apps and websites. That is the core of vendor-neutral, cross-ecosystem passkey sync, and the llms.txt probe also positions it as a passkey manager. missing for 10: explicit per-platform confirmation (iOS, Android, Windows, Linux) of passkey support, evidence of passkey use in the desktop apps, details on how passkeys sync between devices, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
